card.name: Spots just before a number or term
card.fires_on: Small in-between positions in drug-label text, such as the gap before a lab threshold number, the digit inside a section reference, or a linking word like that, by, when. The next word is usually a value, a section number or a recovery or assessment term.

modes.label: Before a lab threshold
modes.description: The space right before a blood count cutoff number after phrases like greater than or at least.

modes.description: The digit inside a cross-reference to a warnings section.

modes.label: Linking words in dosing text
modes.description: A small linking word or verb in an instruction sentence, before a condition or assessment.
